Redaction boxes

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PDF and pick a page number.
  2. Check the page-size helper (width × height in points).
  3. Enter the rectangle's x, y, width and height in points.
  4. Add as many boxes as needed, then "Apply & Download".

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the redactions permanent?

Yes — the boxes are drawn into the page content itself, so they cannot be removed by selecting text or editing layers.

How do PDF coordinates work?

PDF coordinates start at the bottom-left corner of the page, measured in points (1/72 inch). The tool shows the current page's exact size.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
